integrity: The universal claim is supported by a direct structural proof. The verifier independently checks the original neighborhood-multiplicity definition on finite instances and is reported only as a stress test. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a finite simple complete multipartite graph with at least two nonempty parts.
The result concerns ordinary proper conflict-free coloring, not list coloring or h-conflict-free variants with h>1.
Finite enumeration through order ten is a stress test and is not used as an infinite proof.
A residual literature risk remains for older equivalent terminology not recovered by the inspected searches.
title: Exact proper conflict-free colorings of complete multipartite graphs
